details: The Abaia will roam in the water, and every 10-20 seconds will catch an extra fish to put it in the Bank, with a maximum of 5 fish held in the Bank.
Banked fish will be awarded to the player on the next direct catch instead of when they were banked, with the Bank being cleared when the fish are rewarded.
Banked fish have a 100% chance for Abaia's Spite.

abilities.text: Every 0.8 seconds 50% chance to slash for +2% Progress.
During the minigame, a Petrification Bar is present above the fishing bar, which can be filled with Petrification.
Every 2-4 seconds, there is a 50% chance to activate one of the following at their respective chances: • Idol's Judgment (50%) • Idol's Curse (25%) • Golden Blessing (25%)
The minigame begins with the Idol's Judgment state, which does not alter the minigame.
The Idol's Curse state lasts 3.25 seconds:
details: 3% of the progress lost during Idol's Curse state is converted into the Petrification Bar.
Progress gained during this state will not fill the Petrification Bar.

abilities.text: The Golden Blessing state lasts 3.25 seconds:
details: Keeping the fish over the bar will cause the Petrification Bar to accumulate Petrification.
3% of progress gained from Golden Blessing state is converted into the Petrification Bar.
The amount of Petrification persists even after Golden Blessing ends.

abilities.text: Up to 60% chance to apply Idol's Spirit, scaling with the Petrification Bar.
Upon filling the Petrification Bar, sets control to 1.0 and applies Petrified.

recommendations.text: Herculean to increase Control and Progress Speed.
recommendations.note: Controlled if Exalted Relic is not available.

recommendations.text: Starforged Spirit, Sanctified + Twisted to increase Fish Weight, Resilience, True Progress Speed, Forced Progress Speed, and Progress Speed.

abilities.text: Chasm-Stalker has its own Perfect Streak counter, which is displayed next to the normal streak counter while the rod is equipped.
abilities.note: Failing a perfect catch reduces the streak by 15%; Snapping a Reel will reset the streak back to 0

abilities.text: Every 4 seconds, 50% chance to summon a whirlpool in the reeling minigame for 2 seconds.
details: Fish will be pulled towards the whirlpool and gain 15% Forced Progress Speed for the duration of the whirlpool.
Control is gradually reduced by up to 0.1 while the bar is on the whirlpool. Leaving the whirlpool early will stop the Control reduction.
Upon the whirlpool leaving, regain 25% of Control lost and 10% of the Forced Progress Speed gained permanently for the rest of the minigame.
Perfect catch streaks builds up "levels" which will increase Forced Progress Speed from whirlpools by +2.5% every Level.

abilities.text: The "Level" is given by the formula , where the "\textS" variable is the streak.
When catching a Birthday Candle fish, drops a "cake" granting +65% progress • When catching Progress Locked fish, the effect instead grants +46% progress over 12 seconds.
Every 3 catches, activates a "burn" ability for the minigame • Every 0.5 seconds, "burns" the fish, causing rapid movement and granting +2% progress.
